fact: The UNDP Digital Readiness Assessment states that the Bureau des Normes de Madagascar, the national standards body, is a correspondent member of ISO; the report gives no date for the membership, so its published date, December 2025, is used.

The Bureau des Normes de Madagascar says Madagascar joined ISO through the BNM and holds correspondent member status, and two BNM staff attended the ISO General Assembly in Cartagena on 9-13 September 2024.
